config.label: DesignPin project-scoped API key
config.description: DesignPin project-scoped API key. Generate at https://designpin.pro under Project Settings. Required for uploadVersion and listComments tools; not required for createShareLink.

config.label: Firestore project document ID the API key is scoped to
config.description: Firestore project document ID the API key is scoped to. Required when using uploadVersion or listComments.

config.label: API base URL
config.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://designpin.pro. Override only for testing against a staging or alternate host.
